mathematical_result.generic_relation: For a symmetric endpoint relation of maximum degree D, the complete signed original packet has absolute value at most D*pickupDiagonal(T).
mathematical_result.ratio_degree: For a positive ratio set Q, each endpoint index has at most 2*|Q| selected multiplicative neighbours.
mathematical_result.all_rate_ratio: For Q={1,...,floor(exp(epsilon*T/2))}, the complete ratio packet is at most (32/epsilon^2)*exp(epsilon*T) in absolute value.
mathematical_result.disjoint_ratio: The same bound holds after removing ratio edges already counted in the additive gap sector.
mathematical_result.exact_partition: pickupCross equals additive gap packet plus disjoint small-ratio packet plus the direct additively-far, no-small-quotient core.
mathematical_result.fixed_scale_equivalence: All-positive-rate upper control of the direct core on a fixed G is equivalent to SubexponentialOn pickupCross G, with explicit added constant 64/epsilon^2.
mathematical_result.rh_return: AffineFrequent G plus the unproved direct-core supplier implies the canonical RiemannHypothesis through the existing return.
